projects.title: Humane (AI Text Humanizer)
projects.tagline: Utilized Grok API and advanced prompt engineering techniques (Chain-of-Thought, Meta-Cognition, Dual Persona Adversarial) to transform...
projects.description: Utilized Grok API and advanced prompt engineering techniques (Chain-of-Thought, Meta-Cognition, Dual Persona Adversarial) to transform AI-generated text by injecting high perplexity and burstiness, bypassing AI detection. Integrated three contextual transformation modes to vary output tone, alongside a secure admin data workbench featuring human-in-the-loop rating, a diff viewer, and AI detection scoring for future dataset curation.

projects.title: TeNo
projects.tagline: Website version of the TeNo side-panel extension for links, reminders, cart items, and timers.
projects.description: Developed a keyboard-first productivity command center operating as both a standalone web application and a browser extension. Designed a terminal-inspired, multi-tab interface for seamlessly managing saved links, e-commerce carts, and daily reminders with real-time cloud synchronization. Engineered advanced functionalities including rapid keyboard-shortcut navigation, secure user authentication, and a robust background timer that reliably triggers desktop notifications.
features: Multi-tab command center organizes bookmarks, reading cart items, daily reminders, timers, and prompt templates in one interface.
Dual-theme design engine switches between high-contrast Minimalist and modern visual styling modes with zero layout shift.
⌨ Keyboard-first navigation enables complete application traversal, modal actions, and quick searches via keyboard shortcuts.
Version-controlled prompt vault saves, edits, versions, and searches AI prompt templates with custom tags.
⏰ Background notification timers trigger native desktop alerts for task reminders and deep work sessions.
Real-time cloud synchronization keeps links, carts, and prompts instantly synchronized across the web app and Chrome extension.
DPDP and GDPR data sovereign supports instant self-service JSON data exports and permanent account deletion.

projects.title: BitHab (Personal Productivity Web App)
projects.tagline: Personal habit and productivity tracker with multi-calendar scheduling, custom goals, focus timers, and habit analytics.
projects.description: Designed a responsive three-column layout with dual themes and an interactive multi-calendar system. Enabled nested sub-activities, custom goals, automatic streak tracking and note-making features.
features: 3-column dashboard combines a multi-calendar scheduler, daily notes editor, and active goals in one unified view.
Hierarchical goal tracking breaks ambitions into subgoals with visual progress bars and milestone indicators.
⏰ Timely reminders notify you of scheduled events with custom dates, recurring intervals, and instant editing modals.
Markdown daily notes provide fast note taking with search and instant tagging for quick retrieval.
⏱ Deep focus sessions offer customizable countdown timers, fullscreen mode, and detailed productivity logs.
6 adaptive themes support light and dark modes with customizable color palettes.
DPDP-compliant data rights guarantee complete data ownership with single-click JSON export and permanent account deletion.

projects.description: Utilized Breadth-First Search algorithm to calculate shortest path between ghosts and player. Integrated Scatter Mode and Frightened Mode with multiple difficulty levels, adjustable ghost speed, and bonus life rewards.

projects.title: Tsuro
projects.tagline: A digital adaptation of the strategic board game Tsuro.
projects.description: A digital adaptation of the strategic board game Tsuro. Supports 2-8 local players in a turn-based, tile-laying game where the objective is to be the last player on the board.
